## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

*Vitakkattika* (Patthana 13.6) is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and concluding treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka in the Pali Canon. The title refers to the "Triad 'Thought-conception, etc.'" (*vitakka-ttika*), one of the twenty-two primary matrix triads (*tika*) through which conditional relations across mental and material phenomena are systematically investigated in the *Paṭṭhāna* [Nyanatiloka 2007].

 Computational analysis via DharmaNexus reveals widespread Pali-internal textual reuse, showing 802 matches across 81 texts in the Pali canon [DharmaNexus]. As with other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the highest concentration of shared phrasing occurs with structurally related conditional expositions, notably *Tika Hetuduka* (Patthana 4.1; 144 matches), *Vitakkattika* in the *Tika-paṭṭhāna* (Patthana 1.7; 76 matches), *Tika Kusalattika* (Patthana 5.2), and other *Vitakkattika* treatments across the *Paṭṭhāna* cycles (such as Patthana 7.6, Patthana 19.6, and Patthana 23.24), alongside parallels in the *Khandhavibhaṅga* of the *Vibhaṅga* [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches above the threshold are detected [DharmaNexus].
